name: google-multi
description: Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive across several Google accounts at once.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: Lists the connected Google accounts (alias and email).

tools.name: gmail_search
tools.description: Searches emails with Gmail syntax (e.g. "from:alice is:unread newer_than:7d"). account="all" searches every mailbox.

tools.name: gmail_read
tools.description: Reads the text content of a message (message_id) or of a whole conversation thread (thread_id).

tools.name: gmail_create_draft
tools.description: Creates a draft in the chosen account (nothing is sent). Prefer this tool over gmail_send when the user wants to review.

tools.name: gmail_send
tools.description: Sends an email right away from the chosen account. Check the sender account with the user before calling.

tools.name: gmail_modify_labels
tools.description: Adds or removes labels. System labels: INBOX (remove = archive), UNREAD (remove = mark as read), STARRED, IMPORTANT, SPAM, TRASH. Custom labels are accepted by name.

tools.name: calendar_list_calendars
tools.description: Lists the calendars (own, shared, subscribed) of one or all accounts.

tools.name: calendar_list_events
tools.description: Lists the events over a period (next 7 days by default). account="all" merges the calendars of every account, sorted by date: ideal to spot conflicts.

tools.name: calendar_create_event
tools.description: Creates an event in the calendar of the chosen account.

tools.name: calendar_update_event
tools.description: Updates an existing event: only the provided fields change.

tools.name: calendar_delete_event
tools.description: Deletes an event (or cancels it, if it has guests).

tools.name: drive_search
tools.description: Searches Google Drive files (shared drives included). Provide query (free text, searched in the name and the content) or drive_query (raw Drive syntax, e.g. "mimeType = application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet and modifiedTime > 2026-09-01"). account="all" searches everywhere.

tools.name: drive_read_file
tools.description: Reads the text content of a file: Google Docs/Slides as text, Google Sheets as CSV (first sheet), text files as is. For PDFs and binaries, only returns the metadata and the link.
